name: Server:Version
sql: SELECT banner FROM v$version WHERE ROWNUM=1

name: Database:Name
sql: SELECT SYS_CONTEXT('USERENV','DB_NAME') FROM dual

name: Database:Service
sql: SELECT SYS_CONTEXT('USERENV','SERVICE_NAME') FROM dual

name: Database:Instance
sql: SELECT SYS_CONTEXT('USERENV','INSTANCE_NAME') FROM dual

name: Database:CurrentUser
sql: SELECT USER FROM dual

name: Database:InstanceUptimeDays
sql: SELECT ROUND(SYSDATE - startup_time,2) FROM v$instance

name: Sessions:Total
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v$session

name: Sessions:Active
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v$session WHERE status='ACTIVE' AND type='USER'

name: Sessions:Inactive
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v$session WHERE status='INACTIVE' AND type='USER'

name: Sessions:Blocked
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v$session WHERE blocking_session IS NOT NULL

name: Sessions:List
sql: SELECT sid, serial#, username, machine, program, status, event FROM v$session WHERE type='USER' ORDER BY logon_time DESC FETCH FIRST 30 ROWS ONLY

name: Performance:PhysicalReads
sql: SELECT value FROM v$sysstat WHERE name='physical reads'

name: Performance:LogicalReads
sql: SELECT value FROM v$sysstat WHERE name='session logical reads'

name: Performance:UserCommits
sql: SELECT value FROM v$sysstat WHERE name='user commits'

name: Performance:UserRollbacks
sql: SELECT value FROM v$sysstat WHERE name='user rollbacks'

name: Storage:OwnedTables
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_tables

name: Storage:OwnedSegmentsMB
sql: SELECT NVL(ROUND(SUM(bytes)/1024/1024,2),0) FROM user_segments

name: Storage:TopTables
sql: SELECT segment_name, ROUND(bytes/1024/1024,2) AS size_mb FROM user_segments WHERE segment_type LIKE 'TABLE%' ORDER BY bytes DESC FETCH FIRST 20 ROWS ONLY

name: Security:AccessibleRoles
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM session_roles

name: Security:GrantedRoles
sql: SELECT granted_role FROM user_role_privs ORDER BY granted_role
